row.notes: Resolves a placement node's transform into r+0x20..+0x5f (4x4 rows, row 3 the position): rcx placement P, rdx node r; void. r+0x18 = u32 slot (unsigned < 32), r+0x1c = u8 type. The slot maps to a vehicle id through the byte table P+0x988 (0xff = none); the vehicle v is the non-null 16-byte entry of [P+0x948]+0x28..+0x30 with [v+0x58]+0xe8 == id, and no match leaves r untouched. The type goes through the jump table at 0x1458042c4: types 0, 2, 6, 7 and 8 write nothing and a type > 8 writes the identity (0x142f629c7). Types 1 and 4 take the parent node N = [P+0x38+slot*8], resolved first by a recursive call (a null N writes the identity), copy its rows 0-2 and set row 3 to N applied to the point v+0xb00 (type 4) or v+0xb00 + v+0xb10 (type 1). Type 3 takes the type 1 result L from 0x142f629e0 and moves row 3 by -c * row 2, c the float at 0x1460fe940 (0.0 in the file). Type 5 resolves Q = [P+0x238+slot*8] and writes Q x L (0x142f628bd), or the identity when Q is null; the vehicle supplies only a translation in every type. A slot > 31 or unmapped logs 'VEHICLE_PLACEMENT Invalid slot (%d)' only when the log flag and channel are on; an unmapped slot of type 5 then gets a plain copy of the resolved [P+0x38+slot*8] matrix (0x142f62743). There is no cycle guard: the function and 0x142f629e0 recurse into each other. Used by the cutscene SetGarageLocation/SetGridLocation commands (0x14023c600 reaches 0x140240c80 and 0x140240d40 by tail jumps), PitstopCutScene_Initialise, the garage gantry and the crew working on the car. Addon: grid/garage transforms. Callers: census steam 0x2f62580.
